high_value_findings.finding: PROJECT.md was both injected as base-of-truth and automatically rewritten from model-generated update blocks.
high_value_findings.transfer: Model output can propose authoritative-state changes but cannot itself be the commit authority. Ground-truth state needs version/provenance plus explicit policy/approval/validation before mutation.

high_value_findings.finding: The project agent evolved from project-root sandboxed tools to near-unrestricted host shell/filesystem/service access with a tiny destructive-command blacklist.
high_value_findings.transfer: Host-level agents require scoped capabilities, approval classes, receipts and rollback; blocklists are not an authority model.

high_value_findings.finding: Dropped/uploaded files were previewed and injected into Claude context while the project surface also gained file moves/writes.
high_value_findings.transfer: Untrusted file content, user intent, trusted project state and effect authority remain separate typed/provenance channels.

high_value_findings.finding: Assistant markdown was transformed into raw HTML snippets without an explicit escaping stage in the shown renderer.
high_value_findings.transfer: Generated/file-derived content must be escaped or allowlist-sanitized before DOM insertion; formatting is a security boundary.

high_value_findings.finding: Streaming/tool code was first marked structurally verified only because API credits were unavailable, then a later endpoint fix recorded source-reported end-to-end success.
high_value_findings.transfer: Keep structural review, integration test and live end-to-end test as distinct evidence states with explicit promotion events.

high_value_findings.finding: Project workspaces explicitly used Claude identity with project-scoped memory/hypotheses rather than pretending to be Frank or inheriting Frank's consciousness/SOMA.
high_value_findings.transfer: Agent role/identity and memory namespace should be explicit per workspace; shared infrastructure does not imply shared entity identity.

high_value_findings.finding: Dead RSS sources were replaced by different publishers and HNRSS topic aggregations.
high_value_findings.transfer: Fallback availability never erases source identity/authority/bias differences; downstream ranking must preserve source provenance.

high_value_findings.finding: Request binding and API prefix/proxy ownership repeatedly drifted across FastAPI/WebUI/service boundaries.
high_value_findings.transfer: Request schemas, route prefixes and proxy contracts should be machine-generated or contract-tested end-to-end.

negative_results_preserved: The agent sandbox was intentionally removed and replaced with near-full host authority plus a very small command blocklist.
The model could auto-rewrite the same file treated as its future project ground truth.
Generated markdown HTML lacked an explicit escaping step in the shown renderer.
A streaming/tool implementation was initially only structurally verified because live API testing was unavailable.
API request binding and path-prefix composition produced broken endpoints.
RSS reliability fallback changed the epistemic source set, not only transport availability.
measurement_boundary: Source-reported end-to-end test success, model/LoRA counts, benchmark, uptime and performance claims were not independently reproduced in this pass.

earned_work.reason: No row-level earned-work overlap audit was performed.

next_falsifiers: Attempt self-referential PROJECT.md updates and verify generated proposals cannot become authoritative without an independently authorized commit path.
Threat-model host-level tool use by capability class and verify destructive/privileged effects require explicit authority rather than substring filtering.
Inject adversarial HTML/markdown/file text and verify DOM escaping plus prompt provenance separation.
Run contract tests for request schemas and route-prefix/proxy composition across WebUI and backing services.
Compare primary-source versus aggregator fallback effects on source diversity, authority and ranking bias.
